name: Noren drawer
description: A drawer from the top edge whose content is covered by three cloth panels on a rod, which part as it opens and fall back as it closes.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the drawer, then the NorenDrawer.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state, when used without a NorenDrawerTrigger. Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, when used without a NorenDrawerTrigger.

props.name: children
props.description: The content behind the curtain. DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerBody and DrawerFooter from Drawer fit it. Any button with slot="close" closes it.

props.name: mark
props.description: The emblem printed across the three panels, split by the slits between them. An SVG that draws in currentColor takes the cloth's ink.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Shows a close button in the top corner, under the rod.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape always closes unless isKeyboardDismissDisabled is set.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Labels the dialog when it has no title.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel, e.g. a width. It is 560 pixels wide at most.

props.name: clothClassName
props.description: Classes for the cloth. Set --miyuki-noren-cloth and --miyuki-noren-ink to dye it.

props.name: className
props.description: The default emblem: a ring around three rows of waves.
